Agent Name: Corporate_Governance_Expert  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: The agent made the key error of concluding that none of the listed Apple board members fit the criterion, when the intended answer is that one member did not hold a C-suite position upon joining the board. The mistake comes from relying on an incomplete/oversimplified interpretation of the biographies and then incorrectly generalizing that all five had C-suite roles. In particular, the agent failed to distinguish between holding a senior leadership title later in a career and holding a C-suite role at the time of joining Apple’s board, leading to the wrong final conclusion.
